cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3 and Coco-Glucoside #4, no second reinforcing anionic or reset route, no reset intent (C1). Refatting Glyceryl Oleate #7.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - refatting Glyceryl Oleate #7, Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #9 (before Sodium Chloride), Panthenol #12, Glycerin #14. No silicone or fatty alcohol.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: single cationic, otherwise light humectants; could be read as cleansing-led (low)

weightPotential.rationale: Low: depositionLoad light (one guar, weak refatter), persistence low, resetCapacity moderate. One light polymer and weak refatter remain low per the §6 anchor.

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: problem-led 'Anti Schuppen' product with recognized active Piroctone Olamine #6 (7.2 row).
focusPrimary.counterSignal: fragrance #19 and dyes in an itchy-scalp product
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula has a recognized anti-dandruff active; name and claims are anti-dandruff -> scalp_active.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the itchy/tight-scalp role is part of scalp_active (Appendix A Vichy row); secondary cannot repeat the primary.

usageRole.rationale: Treatment: problem-led recognized active route (Piroctone Olamine #6) with anti-dandruff positioning and 'bei regelmäßiger Anwendung'.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: explicit 'juckende, spannende Kopfhaut' positioning ('Deine juckende Kopfhaut wird beruhigt', 'sanft zur Kopfhaut') with supportive architecture - moderate buffered cleansing, Glyceryl Oleate #7, Panthenol #12, Glycerin #14, Malva extract. Counter-signal: Parfum #19 and colorants.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C moderate). T6: nothing not_suited. T4: W neighbor none; C neighbor low keeps coarse acceptable -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: 'Anti Schuppen' in name (E1 high) + dandruffSupport supported -> pass. S-SENSITIVE: 'juckende Kopfhaut'/'beruhigt' (E2, manufacturer, E1 moderate), targeted, prominent comfort route Panthenol #12 (before Parfum #19) -> pass. S-DRY: 'spannende Kopfhaut'/'Spannungsgefühl' (E2 dry), targeted, prominent Glycerin #14/Panthenol #12/Glyceryl Oleate #7 -> pass. Three targets: S-SECONDARY keeps primary dandruff + highest-precedence secondary sensitive, drops dry, adds review_extra_scalp_target. S-FOCUS satisfied (scalp_active primary).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular; equals schuppen expectation, differs from irritationen's gentle (I2: amber, kept). I3: cleansing neighbor none -> no flag.

uncertainties: S-SECONDARY 'distinct E2 claim': itch and tightness are described as dandruff symptoms in the same sentence; standard does not say whether symptom claims attached to the dandruff problem count as separate sensitive/dry claims. Treated as distinct (lexicon match), producing a third target and review_extra_scalp_target.
E2 lexicon lists 'Juckreiz' and 'Spannungsgefühl der Kopfhaut'; inflected variants 'juckende Kopfhaut' / 'spannende Kopfhaut' treated as matches.
E1: claims are on the manufacturer page and look like pack-front text ('Bei Schuppen und juckender Kopfhaut') but no pack evidence is present; graded moderate except the product-name claim.
